name: Keio University
summary: Private university founded in 1858 with two English-based bachelor's degrees: PEARL in economics (Tokyo) and GIGA at the Shonan Fujisawa campus.

ib.text: Both programmes take IB Diploma grades, final or predicted, with screening on documents and no interview. An English test (TOEFL iBT or IELTS) is required, waived for GIGA if your school taught in English.

programmes.name: PEARL (Economics)
programmes.about: The Faculty of Economics' September-entry programme (Program in Economics for Alliances, Research and Leadership): economics studied wholly in English and finished in four years, for a BA in Economics.
programmes.ib: Everyone submits TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic, native speakers included; the application is written in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents only, no interview. About 100 places across three periods; an unsuccessful applicant can reapply in a later period. 2026 guidebook set no cut-off scores or subject rules.
programmes.closesNote: Last of three periods; the first two give earlier results.

programmes.name: GIGA Program
programmes.about: An English-based BA at the Shonan Fujisawa campus across Policy Management or Environment and Information Studies, mixing technology, design, business and policy. You can finish wholly in English; Japanese courses with English support are optional.
programmes.ib: Choose Policy Management or Environment and Information Studies (25 places each); you cannot apply to both.
programmes.selectionNote: Winter AO screening on online documents, with a three-minute English video and a study plan; no interview. About 50 places. September 2027 or April 2028 entry, so choose September.

notes: Fees shown are Keio's AY2026 undergraduate table (2027 not yet published); a first-year entrant also pays a one-off ¥200,000 admission fee.
The application fee is ¥35,000 for PEARL and for the GIGA Winter AO.
GIGA's Spring, Summer and Fall AO rounds need an in-person interview in Japan; only the Winter AO is fully online, so it is the one to use from abroad.
